title: Write 3 comparison battle-cards: Zedu vs Moodle, Google Classroom, and Discord for Bootcamps
description:
Write 3 practical, one-page sales battle-cards for bootcamp program managers comparing Zedu against legacy tools:
1. Card 1: 'Zedu vs Moodle' (Modern cohort channels and live classes vs outdated, complex LMS server administration).
2. Card 2: 'Zedu vs Google Classroom' (Professional cohort communication and role permissions vs basic K-12 homework submission).
3. Card 3: 'Zedu vs Discord' (Structured learning with assignment tracking and AI study assistants vs casual gaming chat without learning tools).

Each card must include: Key Advantages, Where the Alternative Falls Short, Feature Checklist, and Transparent Flat Naira Pricing Comparison. Deliver ready-to-print markdown in the attachment.
rationale: Equips bootcamp operators and program leads with clear comparison evidence to migrate away from fragmented tools to Zedu Pro.
